summary: In the diffuse exact-rank-two chamber with max row leverage <=1/3, the intrinsic pair law mu_k has support exactly on pairs with q_rs=det(u_r,u_s)^2>0: q_rs>0 forces the complementary determinant Delta_rs>0. Therefore E_mu|tau|=0 forces tau_rs=0 only on nonparallel leaf pairs; it gives no condition on q_rs=0 parallel pairs. The account01/B13 complete-graph exact classification remains correct for its stronger hypothesis tau_ij=0 for every leaf pair, but must not be inferred from mu-zero alone. The natural mu-support zero endpoint has at most three finite slope classes plus the hub projective line, with classwise diagonal relations proved in account03/B13 r39.
